name: POST /api/sign/:token/interacted - Confirm a human is working the document
description: Records that a person actually operated the signing page (focused or filled a field), which is what sets workflow_recipients.opened_confirmed_at and writes the 'engaged' history entry. A page load alone never confirms an open, because mail-security scanners fetch and render signing links exactly as a recipient would. Edge cases: the endpoint is idempotent — the first call confirms the open and logs one history entry, later calls succeed and change nothing; an unrecognised or missing 'kind' falls back to 'field_focus' rather than erroring; an unrecognised 'via' is recorded as null rather than passed through; a token that is expired or already used is rejected, so the endpoint stops working once the recipient has signed.

errorCases.message: Invalid, expired, or already used signing token
errorCases.when: token is unknown, past expires_at, or already marked used
the token references a recipient row that no longer exists
the confirmation update or history write fails

testCases.name: Unknown interaction kind still accepted, token still rejected → 401
